title: ReferenceDesignation resource
description: ReferenceDesignation DataSet (MG 8.3.10), the ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage of Pub and Set ReferenceDesignation and the Query of ReferenceDesignation (MG 8.3.13.1, GL-ADR-020) of Get ReferenceDesignation (MG 9.1.10). That a Query is only sent without Source (REQ-RES-REFDES-013) depends on the topic and is a rule of the rule layer (R-2).

ReferenceDesignation.$comment: REQ-RES-REFDES-001 (MG 8.3.10, SF-068): fields of the ReferenceDesignation DataSet: the optional aspects Function, Product and Location

Designation.$comment: REQ-RES-REFDES-001 (MG 8.3.10, SF-068): one aspect: Value, optional Local and Parent

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-MSG-001 (MG 8): a sender adds no key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

Parent.$comment: REQ-RES-REFDES-001 (MG 8.3.10, SF-068): Parent of an aspect: Value, optional Local and IdentificationLink (unencoded)

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-MSG-001 (MG 8): a sender adds no key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

WriterGroupName.$comment: REQ-MSG-024 (MG 8.2.3, MG 7.7): ReferenceDesignation has no Filter

ReferenceDesignationQuery.$comment: REQ-RES-REFDES-012 (MG 8.3.13.1, GL-ADR-020): query parameters of ReferenceDesignation: Parent (non-empty unencoded Identification Link) and optional Aspect; a receiver ignores undefined parameters (tolerant flavor)
